name: voltpeer
description: VoltPeer: battery data plotting, Figure assembly, original mechanism diagrams, scientific writing, planning and polishing.

interface.shortDescription: 电池科研绘图、拼版、机理图、写作与润色。
interface.longDescription: Plot supplied scientific data, assemble Figures, import instrument tables, and plan, write or polish research papers and Reviews using declared author evidence and verified sources.
